title: Only one of them held the seal
text:
Only one of them held the seal. Well, I really tried to like these. We live in a pretty tiny place, so saving space wherever we can is a must.

I always shrink-bag our winter blankets and coats each spring. We did 3 bags of blankets and one of coats. Only ONE bag out of four kept its airtight seal longer than a month. One didn't even make it two weeks.

Very disappointing, and I cannot recommend these bags.
